steps.tx: Partial failure of Mullerian fusion giving a heart shaped uterus with indented fundus is a **bicornuate uterus**. Two horns share one cervix in the commonest anatomical form. It associates with preterm birth and malpresentation more than infertility. Fundal indentation over 1 centimetre outside with a divided cavity is the imaging line between bicornuate and septate.
steps.say: Bicornuate uterus is heart shaped from partial fusion failure with one cervix.

steps.tx: Placing the two anomalies together sharpens their contrast. A **bicornuate uterus** results from partial fusion failure, so its fundus is indented outside and two horns diverge above one cervix. A septate uterus fused normally outside, keeping a flat fundus, but its internal septum never resorbed. Three dimensional imaging captures both surfaces at once, preventing the classic mistake of resecting a bicornuate fundus.
steps.say: Bicornuate uterus is heart shaped from partial fusion failure with one cervix. Septate uterus divides the cavity with a normal fundus and causes recurrent miscarriage.

vis.alt: Side by side labelled comparison of a bicornuate uterus with a deeply indented fundus and two horns against a septate uterus with a flat fundus and divided cavity.
vis.caption: Outer shape separates the two anomalies, since failed fusion dents the fundus while failed resorption leaves the outside smooth over a partition. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Failure of midline septum resorption leaving a divided cavity with normal fundus is a **septate uterus**. It carries the worst reproductive record of the anomalies, especially recurrent miscarriage. Hysteroscopic resection is simple, quick and effective. Miscarriage rates in untreated septate uterus run 40 percent or more in older series, falling sharply after resection.
steps.say: Septate uterus divides the cavity with a normal fundus and causes recurrent miscarriage.

steps.tx: External contour separates septate from bicornuate, so imaging must show the fundus, termed **contour assessment**. Three dimensional ultrasound or MRI provides it non invasively. Ultrasound of the cavity alone misclassifies dangerously. Laparoscopy once settled doubtful cases; three dimensional ultrasound now matches its accuracy without surgery.
steps.say: Contour assessment by 3D ultrasound separates septate from bicornuate uteri safely.

steps.tx: Complete non fusion with two uteri, two cervices and often two vaginas is **uterus didelphys**. Each side may menstruate and conceive independently of the other. An obstructed side presents painfully at puberty with haematocolpos. Each horn has its own endometrial stripe on scan, and pregnancy can occur in either side independently.
steps.say: Uterus didelphys doubles uterus and cervix from complete non fusion.

steps.tx: One duct developing alone gives a single horned uterus, the **unicornuate uterus** covered next in this series. A rudimentary horn may hide a functioning cavity that ruptures if pregnant. Renal agenesis on the failed side is common. The kidney on the side of the failed duct is absent in about a third of unicornuate cases.
steps.say: Unicornuate uterus develops from one duct with renal agenesis on the failed side.

steps.tx: Pregnancy in a non communicating rudimentary horn ruptures catastrophically and is prevented by **horn excision** when found. Diagnosis is often first made only at rupture. Laparoscopic removal of the horn is definitive treatment. Excision is advised before pregnancy, because a horn pregnancy ruptures most often in the second trimester.
steps.say: Rudimentary horn pregnancy ruptures catastrophically, so excision prevents it.

steps.tx: Strassman unification joining bicornuate horns is now rare because outcomes without it are usually good, a **surgery restraint** lesson. Surgery follows only repeated adverse outcomes attributed clearly to the anatomy. Septate resection remains the exception with clear benefit. Tomkins and Jones unification operations survive mainly as examination history now.
steps.say: Surgery restraint leaves bicornuate uteri alone unless repeated adverse outcomes prove causation.

steps.tx: Cervical incompetence accompanies several anomalies and cerclage decisions individualise by history, termed **anomaly cerclage judgement**. Routine prophylactic cerclage for anatomy alone is not supported by evidence. Ultrasound surveillance of cervical length substitutes. Serial cervical length scans from 16 weeks replace a routine stitch in most anomaly pregnancies.
steps.say: Anomaly cerclage judgement individualises by history rather than anatomy alone.

steps.tx: Every Mullerian anomaly earns a renal tract scan because of shared embryology, the **renal screening rule**. Finding agenesis or an ectopic kidney changes surgical planning and counselling. It is a one time ultrasound with lifelong value. The scan also catches a pelvic kidney sitting where a surgeon might not expect it.
steps.say: Renal screening scans the tract for every Mullerian anomaly by shared embryology.
